summary: Accepted after independent Chinese-source and sealed-replay review. The candidate preserves valid dated Zhezong-era chronology while making only three source-required repairs: it keeps Taiping Xingguo early as an undated hold, keeps the undated Gaozong–Wei welcome separate from any reign-wide activity interval, and removes the AD 1067 record misowned by the distinct Zhezong-era Grand Empress Dowager. No source or canonical extraction is changed by this receipt.

sourceEvidence.quote: 太宗太平興國初，增主輦二十四人，改服高腳襆頭；

reviewedChanges.reason: 太平興國初 is an early-reign phrase without a numbered year; the candidate correctly removes only the unsupported AD 976 point and paired hint.

sourceEvidence.quote: 高宗將迎韋太后於郊，因製常行儀仗，用黃麾仗二千二百六十五人。

reviewedChanges.reason: This welcome sentence is undated. The candidate retains both named-source records but removes the full Gaozong-reign interval and only the unsupported Gaozong hint component.

sourceEvidence.quote: 四年，神宗嗣位，詔太皇太后儀範已定，皇太后合設儀衛：禦龍直、骨朵子直差都虞候、都頭、副都頭各一人，十將、長行各共三十人；
哲宗即位，元祐元年，詔太皇太后出入儀衛，並依章獻明肅皇后故事。

reviewedChanges.reason: The fourth-year Grand Empress Dowager belongs to Shenzong’s accession context, whereas p016 is specifically the Zhezong-era record whose independently dated Yuanyou-1 attestation remains.
